objective: Frozen retention-capacity-by-drift factorial stress battery with paired cache-write-matched controls on fresh disjoint synthetic cohorts.
frozen_generator: Y025 16 motif identities, 16 cells, 7 active per episode, up to 9 inactive retained assignments, 8 episode sequence, four-way collision, circular radius 2. Sixteen fresh heldout seeds; separate development seeds.
note: Subcapacity comparison within previously frozen max-nine-slot cap; 16 total motifs/cells and action/matching graph never increased.
arms: same write protocol with legal cached-previous-assignment preferences
primary: For all 12 budget/regime combinations report per-seed sham minus read returning-key churn, per-episode matched cardinality, legality of cached preferences, search calls and cache writes; no selection of favorable regime. Each policy writes only previously observed assignments.
frozen_classification: COVERAGE_LIMITED if fewer than 6 of 12 heldout cells have strictly positive total churn savings; ROBUST_RETENTION if at least 10 cells positive with none negative; otherwise MIXED_FRONTIER. Preserve per-cell benefit/neutral/harm regardless of portfolio classification.
controls: Independent exhaustive Hall maximum-cardinality oracle each episode
Exact seven legal active matches per arm and no reused cells
Equal write counts and occupancy trajectory between sham and read within each seed, capacity, drift
No lookahead, evaluator previous-history never used by either policy
Use disjoint 8 development seeds and 16 heldout seeds; no postresult filtering
Exact parent/source blob, artifact evidence prior to one full regression
claim_limit: Finite synthetic assignment memory only; no learned semantics, biological conclusions, general intelligence, or accepted ref mutation.
